question: How do other teachings compare in value to the Great Liberation Tantra?
premises: The Great Liberation Tantra is the standard of comparison.
A sixteenth part represents a very small fraction.
Other teachings are said not to merit even that fraction.
inference: Other teachings do not merit even a sixteenth part of the Great Liberation Tantra.
uncertainties: The subject of 'arhanti' is implicit and understood as other teachings or scriptures.
plain_english: They do not merit even a sixteenth part of the Great Liberation Tantra.
